residual_risks: The on-chain Initialize-scan resolver that produces pool_init_block + pool_init_block_hash is an operator-side run-time action: the deterministic planner accepts operator-supplied Initialize evidence and refuses to guess, but the live resolve-and-acquire loop still depends on T038's hook-scan resolver and the live endpoints (logged in Attempt-001-developer.json residual_risks).

The already_covered outcome (no new chain reads for a fully-covered re-run) is fully exercised by tests and emitted by plan_per_pool_window + plan_per_pool_window_after_resume; the runner-side wiring that consults PriorCoverage at run time is out of scope for T039 and lives with T100 / T104 (developer residual_risks).

Plan's expected_logical_call_count is an upper bound computed from coverage_to_block - coverage_from_block + 1 distinct event blocks; the actual distinct event block count is unknown at planning time. The invariant is asserted by assert_logical_call_count_equals_sub_ranges_plus_headers downstream using the runner's observed count.

REASON_LATEST_REJECTED and REASON_WALL_CLOCK_REJECTED are exported vocabulary items used by build_per_pool_coverage_report's blocker list, but parse_finalized_pin_payloads surfaces REASON_FINALIZED_UNAVAILABLE / REASON_FINALIZED_DISAGREEMENT / REASON_PROVIDER_RETURNED_NON_FINALIZED / REASON_NON_FINALIZED_BLOCK_REJECTED instead. The helper rejects latest / non-finalized / wall-clock bounds by refusing to substitute anything when the finalized tag is unavailable; the more specific reason codes are reserved for callers that surface them separately.
